remarks: Welcome home to 3201 Moon Rd! Set on just over an acre in a peaceful country setting, this inviting 3-bedroom, 2-full-bath ranch offers comfortable one-floor living with peeks of Chautauqua Lake from the backyard. A stunning country side view from the back yard! The spacious primary suite features a walk-in closet and private bath with a walk-in shower and Jacuzzi tub. An enclosed sunporch offers a relaxing space to enjoy the changing seasons and provides easy access to the backyard, where a beautiful Yukon Valley natural stone firepit creates a welcoming outdoor gathering area. An attached 2-car garage and full, partially finished basement provide additional space for storage, hobbies, or recreation. The sellers have completed several updates, including the boiler with multiple heating zones, hot water tank, electrical subpanel, water treatment system, front patio, and back stoop and fire pit. Enjoy the space and privacy of a country setting while remaining conveniently located near Jamestown, Bemus Point and Chautauqua Lake. Bemus Point Schools!
